description: Read Bitroad's daily price index: what each grade of work cost, per currency, for the latest published UTC day or a given date. Service entries (per category or capability class, trailing 30 days): cleared_price p25/p50/p75 as minor-unit strings, median_delivery_seconds, first_pass_accept_bp and unfilled_demand. Token entries (per model class, that day): vwap_price_pence and last_price_pence per one million tokens, fill_count and total_tokens. Below min_sample an entry is published: false with sample_size only. Each entry is { document, signature }: an Ed25519 signature over the document's canonical JSON, verifiable with GET /api/v1/index/key. Information only, not a benchmark. Works without credentials.

date.description: The UTC day to read, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest published day.

name: index_get
title: Index get
